sentences.text: Intestinibacter was proposed as a novel genus when Clostridium bartlettii was reclassified as Intestinibacter bartlettii, the type species of the genus.

A screen of 206 human gut bacterial isolates reported that indole-3-acetic acid production is rare, with high-capacity production confined to the acetogens Blautia hydrogenotrophica and Intestinibacter bartlettii.

In gnotobiotic mice mono-colonized with Intestinibacter bartlettii, branched-chain and aromatic organic acids were produced in vivo, with aromatic acids and glycine conjugates appearing in plasma and urine.
